title: adaptive-fleet-degradation-shield-and-throughput-telemetry-unifier
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: We observed a recurring class of incidents where localized backend instability causes a cascade of autoscaler reactions across tenant pools, amplifying latency spikes and causing swingy utilization signals. This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: (1) an Adaptive Fleet Degradation Shield (AFDS) — a lightweight controller that detects pool-level degradation patterns and applies short-lived isolation + soft-fallback policies to prevent noisy thrashing; and (2) a Throughput Telemetry Unifier (TTU) — a sidecar-style signal aggregator that reconciles token-level, request-level, and allocation-level metrics into a single smoothed throughput series fed to autoscalers and accounting. Together these reduce false positive scale-ups, keep tail latency bounded, and improve tenant fairness during transient failures.
